title: Environments Config Schema
description: Phase 3 and 4 configuration: the environments to provision a federated user-assigned identity and a GitHub environment for. Each environment references a resource group declared in resource-groups.jsonc.

environments.description: The environments (e.g. dev, prd) to provision a federated user-assigned identity and a GitHub environment for. Each environment references a resource group declared in resource-groups.jsonc.

environmentDefaults.description: Settings applied to every environment that does not set them itself, so they are written once instead of per environment. A value set on an environment always wins. Secrets and variables are merged by name; protection rules and credential settings are filled in field by field.

federatedCredential.description: Defaults for the 'federatedCredential' of every identity, including the workload identities.

githubEnvironment.description: Defaults for the 'githubEnvironment' of every pipeline. The name is always set per environment.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the environment (e.g. Development).

environmentCode.description: Short lowercase code for the environment, used in resource names, the GitHub environment name, and the OIDC subject claim.

resourceGroupId.description: Id of the resource group (from resource-groups.jsonc) this environment deploys into.

pipelines.description: The pipelines that deploy into this environment, each with its own federated identity and the GitHub environment it signs in with. Declare one per kind of access, for example 'infra' (broad rights, including 'Azure Deployment Stack Contributor') and 'workload' (narrower rights, so pushing application code cannot alter infrastructure).

pipeline.description: A federated user-assigned identity and the GitHub environment that receives its client id. Within one environment the identity, federated credential and GitHub environment names must differ between pipelines.

purpose.description: Short label for what the pipeline does, unique within the environment (e.g. infra, workload). Reported in the cmdlet output.

githubEnvironment.description: GitHub environment paired with 'userAssignedIdentity', used as the pipeline's approval and OIDC gate.

name.description: Name of the user-assigned managed identity.

federatedCredential.description: Federated identity credential (OIDC trust) configured on the user-assigned managed identity. The subject claim is not stored here; it is computed by the deployment command from the live GitHub repository ID.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Falls back to 'defaults.federatedCredential.issuer'; one of the two must be set.

subjectType.description: The kind of GitHub OIDC subject claim to bind the trust to. The command resolves this to the immutable subject at runtime. Falls back to 'defaults.federatedCredential.subjectType'; one of the two must be set.

audiences.description: Token audiences accepted by the credential. Falls back to ''defaults.federatedCredential.audiences''; one of the two must be set.

resourceGroupId.description: Id of the resource group (from resource-groups.jsonc) this role is scoped to. The command resolves this to the resource group's full Azure resource ID, which allows cross-environment role assignments without duplicating naming logic. Mutually exclusive with 'scope'.

scope.description: Set to 'subscription' to assign this role at the subscription scope instead of a single resource group. Mutually exclusive with 'resourceGroupId'.

secrets.description: Environment secrets. Merged by name with 'defaults.githubEnvironment.secrets': an entry here replaces the default with the same name.

variables.description: Environment variables. Merged by name with 'defaults.githubEnvironment.variables': an entry here replaces the default with the same name.

requiredReviewers.description: GitHub usernames or team slugs required to approve deployments to this environment.

waitTimerMinutes.description: Minutes to wait before allowing deployments to proceed.

deploymentBranchPolicy.description: Restricts which branches and tags may deploy to this GitHub environment. Enforced by GitHub before the job receives the environment's secrets or its OIDC token, so a workflow on any other branch cannot use this environment's identity. Unlisted patterns already on the environment are removed. Omit to leave the environment's branch policy unmanaged (any branch may deploy, unless set by hand).

branches.description: Branch name patterns (fnmatch syntax, e.g. 'main' or 'release/*') whose workflow runs may deploy.

tags.description: Tag name patterns (fnmatch syntax) whose workflow runs may deploy. A published release runs on its tag, so a release-triggered deployment needs its tag prefix here, e.g. 'infra/*'.
